data.body: OPERATOR DECISION (2026-08-19): RP-01 (dd5a / sandstone-fiendish-auk) Phase-4 research is complete; its documented intent is to use the authoritative Pydantic AI seams rather than bespoke orchestration. RESOLUTION: resolve this independently and consistently with that intent — route rebar's synchronous provider entry through the Pydantic-AI-supported call path so it no longer triggers the deprecated asyncio.get_event_loop() fallback at pydantic_ai/_utils.py:1128, eliminating the DeprecationWarning for test_provider_parity.py::test_the_outbound_payload_is_equivalent_across_providers[frontier] and test_agent_build_invariants.py::test_usage_limits_on_run_not_constructor. Fix the rebar-owned call site; do NOT merely suppress the warning. Keep provider parity and agent-build invariants unchanged.
